label: Local source cache record policy

record_status_meanings.planned: Planning record with no runtime effect.
record_status_meanings.recorded_local: Future local record after explicit runtime approval.
record_status_meanings.normalized: Future normalized metadata draft, not evidence truth.
record_status_meanings.source_observation: Future reviewed observation of a source posture.
record_status_meanings.needs_review: Downstream use is blocked until review.
record_status_meanings.policy_blocked: Blocked by source, privacy, rights, or product policy.
record_status_meanings.risk_blocked: Blocked by privacy, executable, or operational risk.
record_status_meanings.stale: Record may be outdated and must not be promoted.
record_status_meanings.superseded: Record is superseded but preserved for review trail.
record_status_meanings.deferred: Deferred to a future reviewed task.
record_status_meanings.future_live_probe_result: Future vocabulary only, not allowed now.
record_status_meanings.accepted_public_future: Future vocabulary only, not allowed now.

notes: A source-cache record is an observation or draft, not public truth.
Accepted-public status is future vocabulary only and must not appear in current examples.
